about_hero_description: We build simple, open tools that help you take control of your digital footprint — without technical expertise.
about_story_p1: MetaCleaner was born in 2022 from a simple frustration: every time we shared a photo, we were unknowingly broadcasting our location, device, and habits to anyone who received it. We wanted a tool that made privacy effortless — no settings to configure, no data to hand over.
about_story_p2: We started as a small team of developers in Prague, united by a belief that privacy shouldn't require technical expertise. Over two years, we've grown from a weekend side project to a tool trusted by over 50,000 users across 40 countries.
about_story_p3: Today, MetaCleaner processes millions of files each month. Our metadata scanning runs entirely in your browser, and files are deleted from our servers immediately after cleaning. Privacy isn't a feature for us — it's the foundation.
about_values_subtitle: Every decision we make is guided by these core principles.
about_values_privacy_desc: We design every feature around minimizing data exposure. Your files, your data, your control.
about_values_transparency_desc: No hidden tracking, no opaque processes. We tell you exactly what we do with your data.
about_values_accessibility_desc: Privacy tools shouldn't require technical expertise. We build for everyone.
about_values_opensource_desc: Our scanning engine is open source. Verify what we do — don't just take our word for it.
about_values_security_desc: We apply security best practices at every layer, from local scanning to server-side processing.
about_values_innovation_desc: We continuously improve our detection and cleaning algorithms to stay ahead of emerging metadata risks.

privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MetaCleaner collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our service. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data transparently.
privacy_section1_content: We collect minimal information necessary to provide our service. This includes account information (email address) when you register, usage data such as the number of files processed, and payment information processed securely through our payment provider. We do not collect or store the content of your files — uploaded files are automatically deleted after processing is complete.
privacy_section2_content: We use your information solely to provide and improve our service: to process your subscription and payments, to communicate service-related updates, to analyze aggregate usage patterns to improve performance, and to comply with legal obligations. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy_section3_content: Your account data is stored on secure servers in the European Union. We use industry-standard encryption (TLS) for data in transit and at rest. Uploaded files are processed and automatically deleted from our servers immediately after cleaning is complete. We retain account information for as long as your account is active or as required by law.
privacy_section4_content: Under the GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access your personal data, request correction or deletion, object to processing, request data portability, and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the email address below.
privacy_section5_content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at: hello@metacleaner.app. We will respond to your inquiry within 30 days.

home_faq_subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about MetaCleaner.
home_faq_1_question: Are my files safe? Are they uploaded to a server?
home_faq_1_answer: Metadata scanning and analysis are performed locally in your browser — files are never uploaded for scanning. Metadata cleaning requires uploading files to our server for processing. Uploaded files are automatically deleted after cleaning is complete.
home_faq_2_answer: MetaCleaner removes all types of EXIF metadata, including GPS coordinates, device information, date and time fields, and other hidden fields that may be a source of disclosure.
home_faq_3_answer: MetaCleaner supports all common image and document formats, including JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, PDF, and more. Scanning is performed locally in your browser without loss of quality. Cleaning requires a brief server upload — files are deleted immediately after processing.
home_faq_4_question: Is it possible to create custom metadata or a sharing method?
home_faq_4_answer: No. MetaCleaner is designed for secure metadata removal, not for creating custom metadata. Scanning happens locally in your browser, and cleaning is handled server-side with files deleted after processing.
home_faq_5_question: Is it possible to process files larger than 100 MB?
home_faq_5_answer: Yes, MetaCleaner supports files larger than 100 MB. Scanning runs locally in your browser without quality loss. For cleaning, files are uploaded to our server and deleted after processing. Maximum size depends on your connection and device capabilities.
home_faq_6_answer: Basic features are free. For advanced features like batch processing, we offer a premium plan.
home_faq_8_answer: No. We only remove metadata, the image itself remains unchanged in full quality.
